content: KFP v2 cache key = hash of component definition (base image, command, code) + input arguments/artifacts. Identical component+inputs on a later run skips execution and reuses prior outputs. Disable per-task via task.set_caching_options(False); force-bust via execution_options.caching_strategy.max_cache_staleness='P0D'. Any change to base image, command, or input values invalidates the cache key for that task and all downstream dependents.
